items.title: The Bull Case For Eli Lilly (LLY) Could Change Following Raised 2026 Guidance On GLP-1 Demand
items.summary: Eli Lilly recently reported that second-quarter 2026 sales rose to about US$23.0 billion with net income of roughly US$7.10 billion, and the company raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to US$85.0 billion–US$87.0 billion from US$82.0 billion–US$85.0 billion. Management attributed this step-up in outlook largely to surging demand for its GLP-1 diabetes and weight-loss portfolio, reinforcing how central these products have become to Lilly’s overall earnings power.
